description:
You are one of several procurement officers at a hospital network choosing a vendor for a new patient-records system. Each officer has reviewed different parts of the bids and reference checks.

The options are:
- Vendor A (Anstir Lumir)
- Vendor B (Nebre Yergar)
- Vendor C (Moume Fenvokso)
- Vendor D (Talvok Fennol)

Exactly one option is best overall. Which vendor should be selected? Your notes are incomplete: other participants hold information you do not have.

agents.shard_text:
Vendor A (Anstir Lumir):
  - Vendor A does not meet accessibility standards
  - Vendor A has reported financial difficulties
  - Vendor A performs encrypted off-site backups
  - Vendor A is fully compliant with health-data regulations
  - Vendor A currently serves 66 hospital clients
Vendor B (Nebre Yergar):
  - Vendor B includes free data migration
  - Vendor B has high engineering staff turnover
  - Vendor B is financially stable
  - Vendor B has poor references from similar hospitals
  - Vendor B estimates deployment will take 4 months
Vendor C (Moume Fenvokso):
  - Vendor C has reported financial difficulties
  - Vendor C had a pilot cancelled at a peer hospital
  - Vendor C offers straightforward contract exit terms
  - Vendor C has high engineering staff turnover
  - Vendor C reported 1 major outages last year
  - Vendor C quoted a total cost of 353 thousand per year
Vendor D (Talvok Fennol):
  - Vendor D performs encrypted off-site backups
  - Vendor D has strong references from similar hospitals
  - Vendor D imposes heavy penalties for contract exit
  - Vendor D currently serves 5 hospital clients
